title: Finite groups that are the product of every pair of non-conjugate maximal subgroups are soluble
summary: We prove that every finite group that is the product of every pair of its non-conjugate maximal subgroups is soluble, answering Problem 10.34 of the Kourovka Notebook. The almost-simple case was proved by Tikhonenko and Tyutyanov. We treat the remaining minimal-counterexample branch, where the unique minimal normal subgroup has the form S^k, with S nonabelian simple and k >= 2. Two automorphism-stable coordinate subgroup classes satisfying a maximal-supplement criterion produce non-conjugate maximal supplements.
